entities.title: Workspace gates
entities.summary: Two gates cargo test runs over lodestar-core's source: the layer test and the deferred-work gate.
entities.purpose: Holds lodestar-core's integration tests that check the source rather than behaviour: layers.rs fails when a capability uses a feature or use case, or a feature uses a use case; deferred_work.rs fails on a deferred-work comment marker in any tracked source file or a deferred-work folder. Behaviour tests sit beside the code in each module.
